reason: Terminé is the usual French for a Done button that finishes editing; Terminer reads as an order to end something.
Sélectionné is the standard spoken state; Option sélectionnée adds a word the English lacks.
Text and back-translation keep the English meaning; no lock, on/off, unverified or number change.
Ne videz pas le stockage matches Android's « Vider l’espace de stockage » wording; keeps every negation.
text: Échec de la restauration. Rouvrez Volt. Ne videz pas le stockage.
